title: Implement streaming /chat/stream endpoint in chatbot/api/streaming.py
description:
Create chatbot/api/streaming.py exposing a FastAPI POST /chat/stream endpoint that server-sent-event (SSE) streams the turn pipeline progress and final response. Each pipeline step emits an SSE event with step name and status; the final response emits as a 'response' event. Uses the default placeholder pipeline from build_default_pipeline().

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/operations.md
- docs/architecture.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/README.md
- docs/PLANS/ACTIVE/CHATBOT/DISPATCH.md
- chatbot/core/steps.py (created by task g.1)
- chatbot/core/turn.py (created by task g.2)
- chatbot/core/__init__.py (created by task g.1)

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/streaming.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Create chatbot/api/streaming.py with:
   - Module docstring: 'Server-sent event streaming endpoint for the chatbot engine.'
   - Pydantic request model `StreamRequest` with session_id (str) and message (str).
   - A FastAPI `APIRouter` instance named `streaming_router` with prefix '/chat'.
   - A POST handler at '/stream' that:
     * Accepts StreamRequest as JSON body.
     * Returns a StreamingResponse with media_type 'text/event-stream'.
     * Uses an async generator that:
       - Constructs a TurnContext from the request.
       - Iterates the pipeline steps from build_default_pipeline().
       - For each step, emits an SSE event: 'data: {"step": "<name>", "status": "running"}\n\n'
       - After each step completes, emits: 'data: {"step": "<name>", "status": "done", "duration_ms": <N>}\n\n'
       - After all steps, emits the final response: 'data: {"type": "response", "text": "<final_response>"}\n\n'
       - Ends with 'data: [DONE]\n\n'
     * Wraps the generator body in try/except and emits an error SSE event on failure.
   - No imports from langgraph, langchain, letta, or zep.

2. Ensure python -m py_compile chatbot/api/streaming.py passes.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/streaming.py exists with streaming_router and StreamRequest
streaming_router has a POST /chat/stream handler returning StreamingResponse
Handler emits SSE events for each pipeline step
Handler emits final response SSE event
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

introduce LangGraph, LangChain, Letta, Zep, or any orchestration framework
